segments.text: Ha! Can you believe we actually did it? We made it through the storm. Wind howling,
rain lashing. I thought we'd never see the sun again. There were nights. Nights I cried myself
to sleep, whispering, is anyone even out there? But then you showed up. You smiled,
and suddenly the world wasn't so dark. I felt seen, understood. Remember that silly dance in
the kitchen with the burnt pancakes? Oh, we were a mess. But now, now you're gone.
The silence is deafening. I miss you every single day. But I carry you with me,
in every laugh, every tear, every quiet moment. And I'll keep going,
because that's what you'd want. Always.
